paper_title: Searching for Axion-Like Particles with the Blazar Observations of MAGIC and Fermi-LAT
notes: Astrophysical ALP-photon oscillation search using blazar Mrk 421 spectra (MAGIC + Fermi-LAT). Combined 15-phase analysis excludes g_agamma >~ 2e-11 GeV^-1 for ~8e-9 eV <~ m_a <~ 2e-7 eV at 95% CL. Only the approximate corner values from the text are extractable; the full exclusion contour is in Fig. 4 but not given numerically. PG 1553+113 did not set a limit. Not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density assumed. | Vision: Red contour from Fig. 4 = combined Mrk 421 (MAGIC+Fermi-LAT) 95% C.L. upper limit, the paper's main result. The contour is jagged; lower boundary traced approximately. Text states exclusion of g_agamma >~ 2e-11 GeV^-1 for 8e-9 <~ m_a <~ 2e-7 eV. Upper boundary cut off by CAST band at 6.6e-11.
